channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tracy McGrady | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tracy McGrady from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: AJ Dybantsa on Paul George, Tracy McGrady, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
AJ Dybantsa on his NBA player comparisons:

“Some people say younger Paul George. I have heard a bigger Shai, I have heard a bigger Jalen Brunson. But the most accurate one I have ever got was Tracy McGrady. I think he was just super uber-talented, being 6'9, jumping over people to shoot, being a windmill, and being super athletic. I think that is kind of me.”

AJ Dybantsa on Paul George, Tracy McGrady, Jalen Brunson, Jun 26, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Tracy McGrady, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Tracy McGrady’s comments about Jaylen Brown reportedly being frustrated with the organization:

“I talked to Jalen Monday a little bit after…real quickly and it was nothing but positive. He has not expressed those frustrations to me.”

Brad Stevens on Tracy McGrady, Jaylen Brown, May 6, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Tracy McGrady
item.description:
Jaylen Brown on wanting Tracy McGrady to be his mentor:

“TMAC is my inspiration — one of my favorite players of all time. I think I tagged him, and he responded. In that response, I remember he put: Remember humble and hungry. You probably can still find that tweet somewhere. Later, I played in my first All-Star game in 2020 or 2021. I had Adidas put that on the shoes, “Remember Humble and Hungry.”

Jaylen Brown on Tracy McGrady, Mar 11, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: John Salley on Tracy McGrady, Brad Daugherty
item.description:
“I said, ‘Yeah, I want to go back to NBC, I want to work in television.’ I think we need to give a different look or we need to give a perspective that I have watching it for so long and how much I train. But, they gave the job to Brad Daugherty and Tracy McGrady…good for those guys. I’m very happy for them.”

John Salley on Tracy McGrady, Brad Daugherty, Jul 30, 2025. Source: Awful Announcing.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Tracy McGrady, DeMar DeRozan, Jakob Poeltl
item.description:
Libaan Osman:Masai Ujiri on the Toronto Raptors getting the 9th pick in the 2025 NBA Draft:

“Tracy McGrady. DeMar DeRozan. Jakob Poeltl. We’ll be fine. I guarantee you we’ll be fine.”

Masai Ujiri on Tracy McGrady, DeMar DeRozan, Jakob Poeltl, May 12, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Ron Harper on LeBron James, Tracy McGrady, Penny Hardaway, Grant Hill
item.description:
When asked if LeBron James belongs in the category of all-around players like Grant Hill, Scottie Pippen, and Penny Hardaway, Harper offered a different perspective.

“Well,I don’t know if LeBron is a better athlete than what Grant Hill and Penny Hardaway was and what Tracy McGrady was,”

Ron Harper on LeBron James, Tracy McGrady, Penny Hardaway, Grant Hill, Mar 7, 2025. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Vince Carter, Dwyane Wade, Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, Tracy McGrady, James Harden
item.description:
Gilbert Arenas:

“If we really want to have this discussion about Jordan’s competition, just look at the top five shooting guards in history. He didn’t play against any of them in their prime. Kobe’s number two, but he had a young Kobe in ’98. Then you have Allen Iverson, Dwyane Wade, James Harden, Tracy McGrady, Vince Carter—Jordan didn’t face these guys. History is showing you who’s who now because time has gone by.”

Gilbert Arenas on Vince Carter, Dwyane Wade, Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, Tracy McGrady, James Harden, Aug 28, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Paul George, Tracy McGrady
item.description:
Kevin Durant on GOAT conversations:

“I almost say that stuff to challenge people's thinking on why do you even have a GOAT list for one and what does it actually mean in the grand scheme of things? And to also highlight that it is such a subjective thing that I can ask 20 people that you may not ever know or talk to who's their GOAT.And they may say me, they may say Tracy McGrady or Paul George, but what does it matter at the end of the day?”

Kevin Durant on Paul George, Tracy McGrady, Feb 20, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jerry Reinsdorf on Michael Jordan, Tracy McGrady, Jerry Krause
item.description:
“And Krause, if we had done that deal, he was going to take Tracy McGrady and he was gonna take Ron Mercer. “I thought long and hard about it, but my decision came down to this: What would our fans want us to do?’And I concluded that our fans would want us to win a sixth championship, even if it meant we weren't going to be that good afterwards. And that's why I vetoed the trade. I never heard from Michael Jordan about it. If Krause heard anything from Michael Jordan, he would've had to have told me about it.”

Jerry Reinsdorf on Michael Jordan, Tracy McGrady, Jerry Krause, Mar 19, 2022. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Metta World Peace on Kobe Bryant, Tracy McGrady
item.description:
Metta World Peace on who he would rather take the last shot — Kobe Bryant or Tracy McGrady:

“I mean you always gonna go with Kobe because Kobe had five rings and you're just going by the numbers. Now, in their prime it's hard, they was really good.”

Metta World Peace on Kobe Bryant, Tracy McGrady, Feb 11, 2021. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Corey Benjamin on Tracy McGrady, Jermaine O'Neal, Tim Duncan, Jerry Krause
item.description:
Corey Benjamin:

“I had Arn Tellem as an agent and Arn represented a lot of star players. The Bulls were trying to sign free agents. I hosted Tracy McGrady, Tim Thomas and Jermaine O’Neal when we brought them in. I was there personally for those [meetings] because we were all represented by the same agent (Arn).I remember Jerry Krause told me, ‘If you can get them to sign, I’ll renew your contract.’ I don’t remember Tim Duncan coming in, but I know we wanted Duncan. But we weren’t offering them the money that other teams were offering. I remember Tracy and Jermaine telling me, ‘They’re offering me peanuts.’They weren’t trying to max these guys out; they were trying to give these guys smaller contracts.”

Corey Benjamin on Tracy McGrady, Jermaine O'Neal, Tim Duncan, Jerry Krause, May 18, 2020. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Tracy McGrady, Taj Gibson, Larry Bird
item.description:
No. 22 Jimmy Butler:

“I played (in Chicago) with one of the toughest individuals I’ve ever played with in my life — Taj Gibson. He taught me so much about how to be a pro. Sometimes people choose numbers because of someone that inspires them, and Taj is one of those people. I wore 33 at Marquette. In high school, I wore No. 1 because of Tracy McGrady. My best friend, who’s a brother to me and (who) I moved in with, was No. 33. And as much as his family had done for me, I chose it because his mom’s favorite player was Larry Bird, and then it kind of stuck. It was all because of Larry Bird and Jordan Leslie.”

Jimmy Butler on Tracy McGrady, Taj Gibson, Larry Bird, Apr 11, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Evan Fournier on Tracy McGrady
item.description:
G Evan Fournier on Twitter tiff w/ @Orlando Magic Hall of Famer Tracy McGrady:

“I was just giving my opinion - yeah, I think (KDurant) would win against T-Mac. As basketball fans, we argue about topics that have no sense. It’s my opinion. I was surprised T-Mac was all sensitive.”

Evan Fournier on Tracy McGrady, Dec 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @JohnDenton555.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Tracy McGrady
item.description:
His former teammate at Tomball High School Jimmy Rogers:

“He used to roam around the locker room acting like Tracy McGrady,saying he was the next Tracy McGrady”

Jimmy Butler on Tracy McGrady, Apr 12, 2018. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Tracy McGrady
item.description:
Ryan Wolstat:Ujiri on McGrady:

“So happy for Tracy. Becoming a HOFer is a huge accomplishment. As the first Raptor pick to make it, we are very proud.”

Masai Ujiri on Tracy McGrady, Apr 1, 2017. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Vince Carter on Tracy McGrady
item.description:
Carter told The Vertical.

“But we were young guys trying to establish ourselves in the league and that’s what he wanted at the time. … They wanted me to hate Tracy, and that’s my cousin, first of all, that’s all absurd. But they wanted me to have this rivalry and a real beef over that. He’s trying to create his opportunity to be who he always wanted to be, to fulfill the dream of being the go-to guy, the man, the Tracy McGrady that he envisioned. So why hate on that? You can’t.”

Vince Carter on Tracy McGrady, Jan 26, 2017. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Olden Polynice on Tracy McGrady, Stephen Curry
item.description:
Fomer forward Olden Polynice on McGrady's comments to Fox Radio Sports:

“I'm so upset with Tracy McGrady, because I'm like, dude, if you had worked as hard as this kid [Curry], you would have been a Hall of Famer.”

Olden Polynice on Tracy McGrady, Stephen Curry, May 14, 2016. Source: Orlando Sentinel.

item.title: Jabari Parker on Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Allen Iverson, Tracy McGrady
item.description:
“I never watched Michael. I was too young to realize the game. Until I watched Michael Jordan to the Max (the IMAX documentary film). That was way after he retired. It's always been Kobe, it's been Allen Iverson. It's been Shaq (Shaquille O'Neal), Tracy McGrady. Those guys were my idols. He (Bryant) did the unimaginable. Especially after Shaq left, he exploded. Then he won those two championships without him.”

Jabari Parker on Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Allen Iverson, Tracy McGrady, Dec 15, 2015. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Alvin Williams on Vince Carter, Tracy McGrady
item.description:
“We had a mega-star in Vince Carter. We had a star in the making in Tracy McGrady,”

Alvin Williams on Vince Carter, Tracy McGrady, Dec 5, 2015. Source: cbc.ca.

item.title: Vince Carter on Tracy McGrady
item.description:
“Considering where Tracy McGrady came from and what he accomplished, it’s miraculous. Because Tracy had none of the support systems guys normally get to give them a chance. He was taken out of a small Florida hometown, shipped off to (a prep school in) North Carolina when he’d never been away from home. And then shipped to a foreign country. Tracy McGrady is the first high school player that had to play in a foreign country.”

Vince Carter on Tracy McGrady, Aug 27, 2013. Source: Toronto Star.

item.title: DeShawn Stevenson on Tracy McGrady
item.description:
“I saw T-Mac (Tracy McGrady) do 60-something in Orlando against the Wizards; saw Gilbert (Arenas) give somebody 60 in L.A.,”

DeShawn Stevenson on Tracy McGrady, Mar 5, 2012. Source: Newark Star-Ledger.

item.title: John Kuester on Tracy McGrady
item.description:
McGrady could be a key offensive component if he's half the player he was five years ago.

“One of the things that we see (in McGrady) is a player that had high potential at one time, and he is somebody that is working religiously with Arnie, and that's so important...”

John Kuester on Tracy McGrady, Sep 1, 2010. Source: Detroit Free Press.
